title: Things people order or book while some are left: products with stock, workshops and classes with seats, races with places
about: A shop's shelf, a studio's workshops, a club's races: each row a card with its photo, date, price and how many are left. A few left says 'Only 2 left'; none says the out word ('Sold out', 'Full') and offers no action; the rest offer the action, which opens the view that finishes the order or booking with {id} (open), or calls a rule with {id} that checks and lowers the count in one step (call: give the rule a REQUIRE, so two people never get the last one). For dated rows, where 'days_between(:today, day) >= 0' and order 'day' keep the coming ones, soonest first. Use it on a front page or a booking screen: a visitor sees what is on offer, never a form that edits rows.

table.about: the table of things to order or book

eyebrow.about: a short line above the heading

name.about: the column with each one's name

text.about: a column with a line about each one

image.about: a column with its photo (a URL or a file's id)

left.about: the column with how many are left (stock, seats, places)

date.about: a column with its day or time, shown on the card

where.about: an SQL condition on the rows (:today is today)

soon.about: from how many left the card says 'Only N left'

open.about: the view that finishes the order or booking, opened with {id}

call.about: the function or rule called with {id} instead, when one tap is the order (a booking for the signed-in person)

done.about: what the toast says after a call

pay.about: with call: the table of the row the call adds and returns the id of (the order, the booking), to take a card payment for it with app.pay

charge.about: with pay: that row's column holding the amount to charge

paid.about: with pay: that row's status column, set to paid when it is paid

qty.about: true: beside the action a quantity, 1 up to what is left; the call gets {id, qty} (its rule REQUIREs left >= :qty and lowers the count by :qty), the opened view {id, qty}

count.about: true: every card says how many are left, not only when few

{{key}}.sql: SELECT * FROM {{table}}{{where|pre: WHERE }} ORDER BY {{order}} LIMIT 60

Order ' + left + ' or fewer.'), {refused: true}); const made = await app.call({{call|json}}, {{qty|json}} ? {id: item.id, qty} : {id: item.id}); if ({{pay|json}} && made) { const id = typeof made === 'object' ? made.id : made; const p = await app.pay({table: {{pay|json}}, id, amount: {{charge|json}}, status: {{paid|json}} || undefined}); app.payNow(p, {{done|json}}); } else app.toast({{done|json}}); }})
